claim: The comment says the root dict, key, list and items total 1024 nodes at 1021 items, so 1021 items is within and 1022 exceeds the node bound.

evidence: server.py:320 calls copy_bounded_json(forwarded) with defaults max_nodes=1024, max_bytes=16384 (_bounded_json.py:16). visit() decrements remaining_nodes for every value including dict keys (line 57 visits name) and fails only when remaining_nodes < 0 (line 37). {'v': list(range(1021))} counts root 1 + key 1 + list 1 + 1021 ints = 1024, leaving 0, so it is accepted. Byte use for 1021 ints is about 4000, under 16384, so the node limit is the only bound that matters. The comment matches the code.
